# Dot and stem plots - Practice Test - Year 7

Attempt all questions and show your working. Suggested time: 30 to 35 minutes.

## Section A: Consolidating (Questions 1-4)

**Question 1**

The stem-and-leaf plot shows some data. Key: stem $1$ and leaf $2$ means $12$.

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 5 8 |
| 2 | 0 3 3 7 |
| 3 | 1 4 |

(a) How many values are shown?

(b) What are the smallest and largest values?

**Question 2**

A dot plot shows the number of goals a soccer team scored in each match of its season. The number of dots above each value is shown in the table.

| Goals scored | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Number of dots | 2 | 5 | 4 | 2 | 1 |

(a) How many matches did the team play?

(b) What is the mode?

**Question 3**

In a stem-and-leaf plot, one row reads: stem $4$, leaves $0 \ 6 \ 9$. The key is stem $4$ and leaf $0$ means $40$. Write the three data values.

**Question 4**

Draw an ordered stem-and-leaf plot for this data, including a key.

$$23, \ 15, \ 31, \ 27, \ 19, \ 22, \ 35, \ 18$$

## Section B: Standard (Questions 5-16)

**Question 5**

Fifteen students were asked how many siblings they have.

$$1, \ 2, \ 0, \ 1, \ 3, \ 1, \ 2, \ 1, \ 0, \ 4, \ 2, \ 1, \ 1, \ 2, \ 3$$

(a) Draw a dot plot of the data. (For checking, list how many dots go above each value.)

(b) What is the mode?

**Question 6**

The ages of people at a party are shown. Key: stem $1$ and leaf $5$ means $15$ years.

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 1 | 5 7 9 |
| 2 | 2 4 4 8 |
| 3 | 0 3 6 |
| 4 | 1 |

Find the median, mode and range of the ages.

**Question 7**

A dot plot shows quiz scores out of 5.

| Score | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Number of dots | 1 | 4 | 3 | 2 |

(a) Find the mean score.

(b) Find the median score.

**Question 8**

Two dot plots show data on a scale from $1$ to $9$. The number of dots above each value is given.

| Value | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plot A | 1 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 6 | 5 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
| Plot B | 8 | 6 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |

Describe the shape of each distribution (symmetric, positively skewed or negatively skewed).

**Question 9**

The times, in seconds, for students to solve a puzzle are shown. Key: stem $2$ and leaf $4$ means $24$ seconds.

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 2 | 4 6 8 |
| 3 | 0 1 3 5 5 7 |
| 4 | |
| 5 | |
| 6 | 2 |

(a) Which value is an outlier?

(b) Find the range including the outlier.

(c) Find the range without the outlier.

**Question 10**

This back-to-back stem-and-leaf plot shows maths test scores for two classes. Class A's leaves are on the left and are read from the stem outwards, so the leaf $1$ next to stem $6$ means $61$ for Class A. Class B's leaves are on the right, so leaf $2$ next to stem $6$ means $62$ for Class B.

| Class A leaves | Stem | Class B leaves |
|---|---|---|
| | 4 | 8 |
| 5 | 5 | 3 7 |
| 8 4 1 | 6 | 2 5 7 |
| 9 5 2 2 | 7 | 0 4 8 |
| 6 3 | 8 | 1 |

(a) Find the median score for each class.

(b) Find the range for each class.

(c) Which class performed better overall? Give a reason.

**Question 11**

The lengths of 12 fish, in centimetres, are:

$$23, \ 31, \ 28, \ 35, \ 42, \ 26, \ 33, \ 38, \ 29, \ 31, \ 40, \ 24$$

(a) Draw an ordered stem-and-leaf plot with a key.

(b) Find the median length.

(c) How many fish are $30 \text{ cm}$ or longer?

**Question 12**

A dot plot shows the hours of sport played last week by 20 students.

| Hours | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Number of dots | 1 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 3 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 1 |

(a) What is the mode?

(b) Which value is an outlier?

(c) What percentage of the students played 4 or more hours of sport?

**Question 13**

The heights of 30 students range from $142 \text{ cm}$ to $178 \text{ cm}$. Explain why a stem-and-leaf plot is a better display than a dot plot for this data.

**Question 14**

Two basketball players recorded their points in 10 games. The number of dots above each score on their dot plots is shown.

| Points | 4 | 6 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 14 | 16 | 18 | 20 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Player A | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 2 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Player B | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 0 | 2 | 2 |

(a) Find the mean for each player.

(b) Find the range for each player.

(c) Which player is more consistent? Explain.

**Question 15**

The masses of 9 parcels are shown. Key: stem $3$ and leaf $2$ means $3.2 \text{ kg}$.

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 3 | 2 5 8 |
| 4 | 0 4 4 7 |
| 5 | 1 6 |

Find the median, mode, range and mean of the masses.

**Question 16**

Fourteen students recorded how many books they read over the holidays.

$$2, \ 3, \ 3, \ 4, \ 4, \ 4, \ 5, \ 3, \ 4, \ 2, \ 5, \ 4, \ 3, \ 11$$

(a) Draw a dot plot. (For checking, list how many dots go above each value.)

(b) Describe the distribution: where the data clusters, the most common value, and any outlier.

## Section C: Advanced (Questions 17-20)

**Question 17**

A dot plot has 3 dots above the value $1$, 5 dots above $2$, some dots above $3$ and 2 dots above $4$. There are no other dots. The mean of the data is $2.4$. How many dots are above the value $3$?

**Question 18**

The maximum daily temperatures, in $^\circ\text{C}$, for two towns over 9 days are:

- Town P: $14, 16, 17, 19, 21, 22, 22, 25, 28$
- Town Q: $21, 23, 24, 26, 27, 27, 29, 30, 33$

(a) Draw a back-to-back stem-and-leaf plot, with Town P on the left.

(b) Find the median and range for each town.

(c) Compare the two distributions in one or two sentences.

**Question 19**

This stem-and-leaf plot has one leaf missing, shown as $\Box$. Key: stem $1$ and leaf $2$ means $12$.

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 5 8 |
| 2 | 0 4 7 9 |
| 3 | 3 $\Box$ |

The mean of the nine values is $24$. Find the missing leaf.

**Question 20**

The stem-and-leaf plot shows the number of minutes 10 customers waited on a help line. Key: stem $2$ and leaf $0$ means $20$ minutes.

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 2 | 0 2 5 |
| 3 | 0 2 4 4 6 7 |
| 4 | |
| 5 | |
| 6 | |
| 7 | |
| 8 | |
| 9 | 0 |

(a) Find the mean and median.

(b) The value $90$ is removed. Find the new mean and median.

(c) Which measure was affected more by the outlier? Explain why.
answers_md:
# Dot and stem plots - Answer Key

**Question 1**

Answer: (a) $9$ (b) Smallest $12$, largest $34$

**Question 2**

Answer: (a) $14$ (b) $1$ goal

**Question 3**

Answer: $40, 46, 49$

**Question 4**

Answer: Key: stem $1$ and leaf $5$ means $15$

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 1 | 5 8 9 |
| 2 | 2 3 7 |
| 3 | 1 5 |

**Question 5**

Answer: (a) $0$: 2 dots, $1$: 6 dots, $2$: 4 dots, $3$: 2 dots, $4$: 1 dot (b) $1$

**Question 6**

Answer: Median $24$ years (6th value), mode $24$ years, range $26$ years ($41 - 15$)

**Question 7**

Answer: (a) $3.6$ ($36 \div 10$) (b) $3.5$ (5th and 6th values are $3$ and $4$)

**Question 8**

Answer: Plot A is symmetric. Plot B is positively skewed (most values are low, with a tail towards the higher values).

**Question 9**

Answer: (a) $62$ seconds (b) $38$ seconds (c) $13$ seconds

**Question 10**

Answer: (a) Class A $72$, Class B $66$ (b) Class A $31$, Class B $33$ (c) Class A, because its median is higher (and its spread is similar).

**Question 11**

Answer: (a) Key: stem $2$ and leaf $3$ means $23 \text{ cm}$

| Stem | Leaf |
|---|---|
| 2 | 3 4 6 8 9 |
| 3 | 1 1 3 5 8 |
| 4 | 0 2 |

(b) $31 \text{ cm}$ (c) $7$

**Question 12**

Answer: (a) $3$ hours (b) $8$ hours (c) $30\%$ ($6$ out of $20$)

**Question 13**

Answer: There are many different values over a wide range, so a dot plot would have mostly single dots and show no clear shape. A stem-and-leaf plot groups the heights by tens (stems 14 to 17) while still showing every value.

**Question 14**

Answer: (a) Player A $12$, Player B $13.4$ (b) Player A $8$, Player B $16$ (c) Player A, because the range is smaller, so the scores are closer together.

**Question 15**

Answer: Median $4.4 \text{ kg}$, mode $4.4 \text{ kg}$, range $2.4 \text{ kg}$, mean $4.3 \text{ kg}$ ($38.7 \div 9$)

**Question 16**

Answer: (a) $2$: 2 dots, $3$: 4 dots, $4$: 5 dots, $5$: 2 dots, $11$: 1 dot (b) The data clusters from $2$ to $5$ books, the mode is $4$ books, and $11$ is an outlier.

**Question 17**

Answer: $5$ (with $x$ dots: $\frac{21 + 3x}{10 + x} = 2.4$ gives $x = 5$; check $36 \div 15 = 2.4$)

**Question 18**

Answer: (a)

| Town P leaves | Stem | Town Q leaves |
|---|---|---|
| 9 7 6 4 | 1 | |
| 8 5 2 2 1 | 2 | 1 3 4 6 7 7 9 |
| | 3 | 0 3 |

(b) Town P: median $21^\circ\text{C}$, range $14^\circ\text{C}$. Town Q: median $27^\circ\text{C}$, range $12^\circ\text{C}$. (c) Town Q was generally warmer (higher median) and its temperatures were slightly less spread out.

**Question 19**

Answer: $8$ (total must be $9 \times 24 = 216$; known values sum to $178$; missing value $38$)

**Question 20**

Answer: (a) Mean $36$ minutes, median $33$ minutes (b) Mean $30$ minutes, median $32$ minutes (c) The mean, which dropped by $6$ while the median dropped by $1$. The mean uses every value, so one very large value pulls it up.
